about: The remote-crowd cost ladder as rows (World, S2: 40 characters at 30 fps; Lead's ladder 16/4 -> 8/4 -> 4/8 -> 0/12). Rung 0 is the full treatment; the frame governor (frame-governor.ts) steps one rung down when the frames' p95 stays over remoteAdaptSlowMs for a window and one back up when it stays under remoteAdaptOkMs. `full`: how many of the nearest remote figures are FULL (the rest are cheap: no trail, no shadow cast); `every`: a cheap figure is posed once per this many frames. Rung 0 equals the old remoteFullCount 16 / remoteCheapEvery 4 and rung 1 the old remoteAdaptFullCount 8.
